why: The other half of the density difference: the soot goes back to the ordinary puff's squared thinning, so it is only briefly thicker and has given up 56% of itself a third of the way through its life. The raw-opacity assertion stays green under this -- the refusal still starts denser -- which is exactly why the suite compares each cloud against its OWN birth density as well. A retune that kept the higher peak and dropped the curve would look like a simplification and would quietly return most of the measured separation.
